settings.headline: Built for answers you can verify.
settings.intro: TraceKit is focused on a simple problem: business data is fragmented across platforms, while decisions depend on seeing the full picture.
settings.note: Company history and team biographies can be added when approved.

settings.heading: Our mission
settings.body: Connect clicks, customers, commercial events, and financial evidence into a clearer operational picture.

settings.heading: Our approach
settings.body: Preserve source records, favor deterministic relationships, and make unresolved information visible.

settings.heading: Our philosophy
settings.body: Track. Reconcile. Trust. Answers should be explainable, not merely attractive.
